easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
description:
Cast Uro by paying {1}{G}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Uro spell three times.
Resolve the first Uro copy, triggering both of its enter abilities.
If you control more than one Uro, put all but one in the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Resolve Uro's first ability, sacrificing it unless it escaped.
Resolve Uro's second ability, gaining 3 life, drawing a card, and putting Oboro, Palace in the Clouds from your hand onto the battlefield.
Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, triggering Evolution Sage.
In response, activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath
uses.cardState: At least five additional cards in your graveyard
